Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 4 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 4, 11:20 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs has the highest SPAGS projection in the Lions at Panthers DraftKings Showdown: 26.5 points at $12,000 FLEX, 39.7 at captain for $18,000. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs holds 78% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 31.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Gibbs at captain. Amon-Ra St. Brown is the next captain in line, at 10.6%. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes.

Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 27.5 for the Lions and 24 for the Panthers.

Behind Gibbs and Brown, the next projections are Jared Goff (18.5, $10,000), Bryce Young (18.0, $9,800) and Chuba Hubbard (16.4, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 4, 11:20 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jahmyr Gibbs, DET RB ($12,000 FLEX / $18,000 CPT)

Jahmyr Gibbs holds 31.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $18,000 and the 26.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 39.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 22.9 carries and 5.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 26.6 points with a simulated floor of 14.3 and a ceiling of 42.7. He holds 78% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 31.3% as the captain and 47.1% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Amon-Ra St. Brown holds 10.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 19.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 10.5 targets on 31.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.7 and a ceiling of 38.4. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.6% as the captain and 35.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Tetairoa McMillan holds 10.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 15.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.0 targets on 35.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations McMillan averaged 15.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 35.8. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.4% as the captain and 27.6% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Lions vs Panthers

Jared Goff, DET QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jared Goff carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 18.5 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 33.9. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.9% as the captain and 45.4% in a FLEX spot.

Bryce Young, CAR QB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Bryce Young carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 18.0 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Young averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 32.7. He holds 52% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.2% as the captain and 44.4% in a FLEX spot.

Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Chuba Hubbard carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.4 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 17.7 carries and 3.8 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hubbard averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 30.6. He holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.6% as the captain and 35.6% in a FLEX spot.

Sam LaPorta, DET TE ($6,600 FLEX / $9,900 CPT)

Sam LaPorta carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.6 DraftKings points for a $6,600 FLEX salary ($9,900 at captain). The model gives him 4.9 targets on 31.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations LaPorta averaged 12.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.2% as the captain and 29.8% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Brock Wright, DET TE ($1,600 FLEX / $2,400 CPT)

Brock Wright projects for 4.4 DraftKings points at a $1,600 FLEX salary, 2.74 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 1.2 targets on 9.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Wright averaged 4.4 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 13.1. He holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.5% as the captain and 12.4% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Brycen Tremayne, CAR WR ($2,600 FLEX / $3,900 CPT)

Brycen Tremayne projects for 6.6 DraftKings points at a $2,600 FLEX salary, 2.55 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.9 targets on 23.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Tremayne averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 19.2. He holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.8% as the captain and 20.9% in a FLEX spot.

Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 31.3%, ahead of Amon-Ra St. Brown (10.6%) and Tetairoa McMillan (10.4%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Lions vs Panthers?

Build around Jahmyr Gibbs at captain with Jared Goff, Bryce Young and Sam LaPorta at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (21 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $5,600 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs leads the SPAGS model at 26.5 DraftKings points for $12,000 at FLEX, or 39.7 points at captain for $18,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Lions vs Panthers Showdown?

Jahmyr Gibbs is the most expensive player at $12,000 FLEX and $18,000 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Lions vs Panthers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Brock Wright (4.4 points at $1,600), Brycen Tremayne (6.6 points at $2,600) and John Metchie III (8.1 points at $3,200).

What is the Lions vs Panthers spread and total?

The Lions are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 51.5, with implied team totals of 27.5 for the Lions and 24 for the Panthers.
